name: Eligibility or Benefit Information
sourceRefs: Stedi (stedi.com/edi/x12-005010/segment/EB) — X12 005010 EB segment element reference, cross-checked against the HIPAA-specific 271 (005010X279A1) transaction-set guide (stedi.com/edi/edi/hipaa/transaction-set/271-B1). One EB per 2110C/2110D loop instance (loop repeats >1 — same 'repetition lives at the loop level' modeling as EQ.json). EB01 is the real eligibility/benefit answer code (e.g. '1'=Active Coverage, '6'=Inactive, 'A'=Co-Payment, 'B'=Co-Insurance, 'C'=Deductible — carries the actual determination made by whatever real system produced this 271; this engine only structurally maps it, never invents it). EB09/EB10 are a paired quantity qualifier+value (P0910 constraint: both present or neither).
